name: Skaler
author: Skaler
description: Meta ads creative analytics, competitor ad research and ad launching for Claude, ChatGPT and other MCP clients.

tools.name: get_workspace
tools.description: Your plan, ad accounts (always including the demo account), brands and AI-tag categories. Assistants call it first.

tools.name: query_creatives
tools.description: Ranked ads with spend, ROAS, CPA, CTR, hook and hold rate, Skaler's four creative scores, AI tags and thumbnails. Filter and group by any of them.

tools.name: get_ai_tag_performance
tools.description: Which hooks, angles, personas, formats and offers win in the account, with spend share for each.

tools.name: get_account_summary
tools.description: KPIs against the previous period, a daily trend and the top ads. Can return a ready-made Slack or markdown update.

tools.name: get_breakdowns
tools.description: Spend or ROAS split by platform, placement, format, country, age and gender.

tools.name: get_ad_insights
tools.description: The transcript and AI analysis already created in Skaler for one ad.

tools.name: list_reports
tools.description: Your saved Skaler reports (sample reports on the demo account).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: Runs one of your saved reports with live data.

tools.name: search_winning_ads
tools.description: Finds winning ads in any niche from Skaler's ad library, with run time and scaling signals.

tools.name: spy_on_brand
tools.description: What one brand is running and scaling right now: active ads, formats, landing pages and longest runners.

tools.name: analyze_ad_creative
tools.description: Breaks down one ad: hook, angle, structure, copy and why it likely works.

tools.name: list_tracked_brands
tools.description: The brands you follow in Skaler's Brand Spy.

tools.name: get_launch_options
tools.description: Your campaigns (CBO or ABO), ad sets, Pages, Instagram accounts and call-to-action types.

tools.name: create_campaign
tools.description: A new, empty Meta campaign with any objective, ABO or CBO.

tools.name: create_launch_draft
tools.description: Builds a draft in Skaler's launcher from creative links: which ad set to copy, copy, link, budget and schedule. Returns a summary and a link to review it.

tools.name: launch_draft
tools.description: Uploads the creatives and creates the ad sets and ads from an approved draft. Needs the ad count and ad set name from the draft summary.

tools.name: get_launch_status
tools.description: What a launch created, with Meta ad and ad set IDs, and why any ad failed.

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Sends a bug report or idea to the Skaler team when you ask your assistant to.
